description: This file defines the CandidateAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It maps to the 'ohrm_job_candidate_attachment' table and includes properties such as id, candidate, fileName, fileType, fileSize, fileContent, and attachmentType, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: CandidateAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a candidate's attachment in the recruitment module, mapped to 'ohrm_job_candidate_attachment', with properties for file details and associated candidate.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the file, if available.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the file.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file (resource or string).

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the attachment type, if set.
